additional_info.subject: RE: ID0471461-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R8 170002447]Check on logs CRM:00263000364
additional_info.body:
Dear Rosita,
I've thoroughly reviewed the logs for your charging session. Here's what we found:
During the session, your EV's pilot state transitioned from 'C' to 'B'. For a charging session with power delivery to proceed safely and correctly, the EV needs to maintain a 'C' pilot state. When our system detected this change to pilot state 'B', it, in accordance with industry standards, initiated a safe termination of the charging session. This is a built-in safety measure to prevent any potential issues.
Interestingly, after the session was already aborted by our system, your EV's pilot state then transitioned back from 'B' to 'C'. In this scenario, the EV's internal safety protocols often engage, causing it to lock the charging plug. This locking mechanism is entirely controlled by the EV itself to ensure safety.
Based on our analysis, the charger operated as expected and responded appropriately to the changes in your EV's pilot state. Therefore, there was no malfunction or incorrect behavior from the charging station in this instance.
Given these findings, I will be proceeding to close this ticket. However, if you have any further questions or if this issue recurs, please don't hesitate to open a new ticket, and we'll be happy to assist you further.
Thank you for your understanding.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
